title: : "Unilateral Travel Ban Without Due Process — 'Cierta Categoria Donde No Puede Viajar Con Nosotros'"

confidence.derivation_formula: value = round( sum_per_article( applicability_weight × element_grid.weighted_score ) / sum_of_weights × authorities_verification_factor, 2 ); authorities_verification_factor = 0.85 + 0.15 × verified_ratio = 0.850

allegation_summary: STG-29 SEG 122 and json_latam_STG_2 SEG 16 record LATAM staff stating that the passenger has been placed in 'cierta categoria donde no puede viajar con nosotros' — a unilateral, undocumented travel ban imposed by a private carrier without any due-process instrument: no written decision, no statement of grounds, no appeal channel, no statutory authority. The 'category' is communicated verbally and is referenced again in the next-day boarding denial chain (CL-006). Combined with the fact that the underlying allegations were already disproven by PDI, the ban is ultra vires and an arbitrary act in the sense of CONST Art. 19.2 and Art. 19.3, and a defective service under LPDC Art. 23.

articles.article_name: Codigo Aeronautico de Chile, Art. 133 — Travel Ban Sin Debido Proceso
articles.article_text: En el evento que el transportador prevea que tendra que denegar el embarque de uno o mas pasajeros por sobreventa, los cuales se hubieren presentado oportunamente y cuyo billete de pasaje estuviere previamente confirmado en un vuelo determinado, debera pedir en primer lugar que se presenten voluntarios que renuncien a sus reservas a cambio de determinadas prestaciones y reparaciones que se acuerden entre los voluntarios y el transportador.
articles.applicability_rationale: A unilateral, undocumented 'cierta categoria' travel ban imposed on a consumer by a private carrier without statutory authority, written decision, statement of grounds, or appeal channel is ultra vires and arbitrary under CONST Art. 19.2/19.3. | legacy paraphrase: Denegacion de Embarque — En caso de denegacion de embarque, el transportador debera ofrecer al pasajero, a su eleccion: (a) embarque en el siguiente vuelo disponible; (b) reembolso del precio del billete; o (c) transporte de retorno al punto de origen. Ademas, debera pagar una compensacion monetaria minima conforme a la tabla del numeral 2 del mismo articulo.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Ley del Consumidor, Art. 13 — Prohibición de discriminación arbitraria
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text of CL.LPC.Art.13 from bcn.cl/leychile
Confirm that Art. 13 applies to air transport services and covers unilateral category-based travel bans
Check SERNAC or court decisions applying Art. 13 to airlines for discriminatory denial of boarding
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: A private carrier imposing an opaque 'cierta categoría' ban likely constitutes arbitrary discrimination prohibited under Art. 13 of the Consumer Protection Law. The provision directly addresses consumer-provider relations and does not require a state actor.
candidate_articles.history_note: Proposed because the incident involves a private carrier's unilateral, category-based travel ban with no due process, which squarely raises consumer discrimination issues under Ley 19.496.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Constitución Política, Art. 19 N° 2 — Igualdad ante la ley
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text of CL.CPR.Art.19 numeral 2 from bcn.cl/leychile
Analyze horizontal applicability of constitutional equality right against private carriers in Chilean jurisprudence
Review recurso de protección cases where private discrimination was challenged under Art. 19 N° 2
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The right to equality is traditionally directed at the state; however, Chilean courts have extended it to private actions through the recurso de protección when the conduct is arbitrary or illegal. Its inclusion is flagged for agent-fit mismatch as the primary duty-bearer is the state, but it may indirectly support a claim against LATAM.
candidate_articles.history_note: Included as a foundational norm that could underpin a constitutional complaint, despite the private nature of the defendant.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Código Civil, Art. 1545 — Efecto vinculante del contrato (lex contractus)
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text of CL.CC.Art.1545 from bcn.cl/leychile
Verify that the contract of carriage does not contain a valid clause allowing unilateral category bans
Examine whether a 'cierta categoría' ban constitutes a breach of the contract's binding force
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The airline's unilateral imposition of a travel ban may violate the principle of pacta sunt servanda, absent a contractual stipulation or legal authorization. This could give rise to a breach of contract claim under civil law.
candidate_articles.history_note: Proposed to address the contractual dimension of the incident, complementing the aeronautical code and consumer statutes.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Código Aeronáutico, Art. 137 — Compensación por denegación de embarque
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text of CL.CACH.Art.137 from bcn.cl/leychile
Confirm the compensation rates and conditions for denial of boarding not covered by Art. 133
Check whether the 'cierta categoría' ban qualifies as a de facto denial of boarding triggering Art. 137 remedies
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Even if Art. 133 was established, Art. 137 may provide additional monetary compensation or specify the calculation method. It is a natural extension of the aeronautical code's scheme for passenger rights.
candidate_articles.history_note: Added as a potentially overlooked provision within the same statute that could increase the carrier's financial liability.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Ley N° 19.628 sobre protección de la vida privada, Art. 12 — Derecho de acceso a datos personales
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text of CL.LPDP.Art.12 from bcn.cl/leychile
Investigate whether LATAM maintains internal watchlists or 'categories' based on personal data processing
Determine if the passenger can exercise access, rectification, or opposition rights under this law regarding the alleged 'cierta categoría'
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: If the 'cierta categoría' is based on automated profiling or a private blacklist, the passenger may have data subject rights under Chilean data protection law. This is speculative but plausible in modern airline operations.
candidate_articles.history_note: Proposed due to the opaque nature of the travel ban, which might involve personal data processing without transparency.
